Docker 部署中保存到 .env 时会自动写成 $$content_json: In Docker deployments, when saved to .env, values are automatically written as $$content_json and $$title_json; at runtime they are still restored to single $ placeholders.
Docker 部署中，`--env-file` / Compose `env_f: In Docker deployments, `--env-file` / Compose `env_file` only injects environment variables at startup; the file exported/imported here is the backend's currently active `.env` file. If you need values saved by the WebUI to persist across container rebuilds, point `ENV_FILE` to a writable data volume file such as `/app/data/runtime.env`, and avoid retaining old values with the same names in the startup environment.

使用现有单股研究内核分析美股，核验行情、趋势、新闻与基本面；不可用的数据明确标注: Use the existing single-stock research core to analyze U.S. stocks, verifying quotes, trends, news, and fundamentals; unavailable data will be clearly marked, and no orders will be generated.
使用真实数据与模型，可能产生调用费用。: Uses real data and models; usage fees may apply.
使用统一字段卡片维护当前分类的系统配置。: Use unified field cards to maintain the system configuration for the current category.
使用英文逗号分隔策略名；留空使用默认策略（bull_trend）；设为 all: Separate strategy names with commas; leave blank to use the default strategy (bull_trend); set to all to enable all strategies.
使用邀请码注册，并自行设置登录邮箱和密码。对话、报告和持仓仅属于你，每日额度由管: Register with an invitation code, and set your own login email and password. Conversations, reports, and holdings belong only to you; the daily quota is set by the administrator.
使用默认模型时，默认值让每个子 Agent 使用各自预设步数；调高后统一提升，调: When using the default model, the default value lets each sub-Agent use its own preset step count; increasing it raises them uniformly, and decreasing it trims the preset step count. When using Codex, this value limits how many times data tools can be called in one stock query.
使用默认模型配置时，这个字段不会改变分析任务线程数。: When using the default model configuration, this field does not change the number of analysis task threads.
例如 deepseek 会对应 LLM_DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL、LL: For example, deepseek corresponds to LLM_DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL, LLM_DEEPSEEK_API_KEY(S), and LLM_DEEPSEEK_MODELS.
例如 港股日线数据库: e.g. Hong Kong stock daily database

修改名称不会自动迁移旧渠道的所有外部环境变量。: Changing the name does not automatically migrate all external environment variables for the old channel.
修改后保存配置即可供后续任务读取。: After changes, save the configuration so subsequent tasks can read it.
修改后新旧 HMAC 不再可比较，应同步更新 LLM_USAGE_HMAC_KE: After the change, old and new HMACs are no longer comparable; update LLM_USAGE_HMAC_KEY_VERSION accordingly.
修改后通常需要重启进程，已初始化的 logger 不一定会立即切换目录。: After the change, the process usually needs to be restarted; an already initialized logger may not switch directories immediately.
修改后部分运行时组件可能需要重启才能完全生效。: After the change, some runtime components may need to be restarted to take full effect.
修改市场、行业或条件后需重新预览。自定义范围会调用模型；核对下方名单后，保存策略: After changing the market, industry, or conditions, preview again. A custom scope calls the model; after reviewing the list below, saving the strategy confirms this scope.
修改目录后需要确保新目录中包含有效的策略定义文件。: After changing the directory, ensure the new directory contains valid strategy definition files.
修改邮箱需要重新验证，请联系管理员。: Changing the email requires re-verification; please contact the administrator.
修改邮箱需要验证当前密码，并使其他会话失效。登录保护不能通过网页关闭。: Changing the email requires verifying the current password and invalidates other sessions. Login protection cannot be disabled via the web page.
候选名单不是买入建议，也不会自动进入交易。: The candidate list is not a buy recommendation and will not automatically enter trading.
候选排序只是演示交互。真实试用可以讨论筛选逻辑，但不执行全市场扫描。: Candidate ranking is only a demo interaction. A real trial can discuss screening logic, but does not perform a full-market scan.
候选深研负责逐股生成研究报告，与前面的筛选规则分工不同。额外调用数据和模型，最多: Candidate deep research generates a research report for each stock, with a different role from the earlier screening rules. It makes additional data and model calls for up to 3 stocks; it does not rewrite the original ranking.
偏防守的质量型候选，优先选择波动较低、回撤浅、估值不过热且数据质量可靠的股票: Defensive quality candidates, prioritizing stocks with lower volatility, shallow drawdowns, non-overheated valuations, and reliable data quality
停止请求未确认，请刷新运行状态后重试。: Stop request was not confirmed; refresh the run status and try again.
停止请求未确认，请重试；其他会话不会被停止。: Stop request was not confirmed; please try again. Other sessions will not be stopped.
停止请求未确认，请重试；当前状态以后台为准。: Stop request was not confirmed; please try again. The backend is authoritative for the current status.
停止请求未送达，分析仍在继续。请再次停止或稍后重试。: Stop request was not delivered; analysis is still continuing. Stop again or try again later.
允许 bot dispatcher 通过自然语言识别将股票查询路由到 Agent: Allow the bot dispatcher to route stock queries to the Agent through natural language recognition.
允许主分析路径主动发送已验证 provider-specific cache h: Allow the main analysis path to proactively send verified provider-specific cache hints.
允许向已验证 provider/route 主动发送 prompt_cache_: Allow proactively sending cache hints such as prompt_cache_key, cache_control, or user_id to verified providers/routes; by default, do not send them to unknown gateways.
允许风控 Agent 在发现关键风险时否决买入信号。: Allow the risk control Agent to veto buy signals when it detects critical risks.
允许风险 Agent 在检测到关键风险信号时否决买入信号。: Allow the Risk Agent to veto buy signals when it detects critical risk signals.
先不布局: Do not build a position yet
先不建仓: Do not open a position yet
先体验一下 · 无需注册: Try it first · No registration required
先保存策略，再选择历史回测、运行一次或持续模拟，分别积累验证记录。: First save the strategy, then choose historical backtesting, a single run, or continuous simulation to accumulate validation records respectively.
先在页面顶部选择当前股票，再查看最新信号和时间线。: First select the current stock at the top of the page, then view the latest signal and timeline.
先完成渠道配置并测试，再选择报告、告警分别发送到哪些渠道。留空会使用所有已配置渠: First complete and test channel configuration, then choose which channels receive reports and alerts. Leaving it blank uses all configured channels.
先定义风险，再等待有证据的交易触发。: Define risk first, then wait for evidence-backed trade triggers.
先寻找永久损失风险。: Look for risks of permanent loss first.
先按市场和行业取得候选，再由模型判断你描述的市值、波动、流动性等条件。上方股票可: First obtain candidates by market and industry, then let the model evaluate conditions such as market cap, volatility, and liquidity that you describe. The stocks above are optional; if filled, screening is limited to those stocks. The preview shows data coverage; for Hong Kong stocks, you must specify stocks first.
先浏览演示报告，再用独立试用身份提出自己的问题。演示不会读取真实账户，也不会消耗: First browse the demo reports, then ask your own questions using a separate trial identity. The demo does not read real accounts or consume model quota.
先添加至少一个已启用渠道并填写模型，下面的主模型 / 备选模型 / Vision: Add at least one enabled channel and fill in a model first; only then will the Primary model / Fallback model / Vision options below appear.
先用一个 Webhook 验证成功，再扩展到多个目标。: First verify successfully with one Webhook, then expand to multiple destinations.
先用确定性工具过滤和压缩市场候选，再让选股 Agent 在授权范围内比较与解释。: First use deterministic tools to filter and compress market candidates, then let the stock selection Agent compare and explain within the authorized scope.
先用自然语言表达目标。Agent 按可用能力研究，实际候选与未验证条件会在结果中: First express your goal in natural language. The Agent researches based on available capabilities; actual candidates and unverified conditions will be explained in the results.
先看证据与日期，再看反方观点，最后检查风险与失效条件。这里没有真实持仓、收益承诺: First look at the evidence and dates, then the opposing views, and finally check risks and invalidation conditions. There are no real positions, return guarantees, or automated trading here.
先补齐协议、Base URL、API Key 和模型配置，再执行一键测试。: First complete the protocol, Base URL, API Key, and model configuration, then run the one-click test.
先选择一个通知渠道并完成其最小配置，再测试发送；报告与告警最后再决定走哪些已启用: First select a notification channel and complete its minimal configuration, then test sending; decide which enabled channels reports and alerts will use last.
先选择任务，再定义运行对象和触发节奏。: First select a task, then define the run target and trigger cadence.
先选择本次授权能力，再为每位专家分配子集。未自定义的专家继承公共配置；配置随讨论: First select the capabilities authorized for this session, then assign a subset to each expert. Experts without custom settings inherit the shared configuration; settings are saved with the discussion.
先选择预设服务商，再一键创建配置草稿。: First select a preset provider, then create a configuration draft with one click.
免密钥公共接口，提供中国 GDP、CPI、PPI 和 PMI；属于第三方聚合数据: Keyless public API providing China GDP, CPI, PPI, and PMI; it is third-party aggregated data, and source and time are retained at runtime.
免密钥定向检索财经媒体、企业公告线与监管机构；只保存标题、摘要、时间、来源和原文: Keyless targeted search of financial media, corporate announcement feeds, and regulators; only titles, summaries, times, sources, and original links are saved.
免密钥高频市场观测：美债 10Y、美元、人民币、日元、VIX、原油和铜；不替代官: Keyless high-frequency market observations: US 10Y Treasury, USD, CNY, JPY, VIX, crude oil, and copper; does not replace official low-frequency macro releases.
全局 JSON body 模板，会先于 Bark、Slack、Discord 等: Global JSON body template, applied before automatic payloads for Bark, Slack, Discord, etc.; $content_json / $title_json are recommended; bare $content / $title are not JSON-escaped.
全球资产的重要折现率锚: Key discount rate anchor for global assets
内置 Skill 可参与正式单股报告；自定义 Prompt 用于 Agent 补: Built-in Skills can participate in formal single-stock reports; custom Prompts are used by the Agent for supplementary research and do not change the underlying data retrieval. Selections are saved with the task together with the strategy version.
内置工具目录读取失败，请稍后重试。: Failed to load the built-in tools directory. Please try again later.
写明输入、分析步骤、输出结构和限制条件: Specify inputs, analysis steps, output structure, and constraints
决定本地 CLI 生成失败后，是直接报错，还是再尝试默认模型配置。: Determines whether to report an error directly or retry with the default model configuration after local CLI generation fails.
决定系统用哪种方式生成个股分析、大盘复盘和普通文本回复。: Determines how the system generates single-stock analysis, market reviews, and regular text replies.
决定美元资产机会成本: Determines the opportunity cost of USD assets
决定问股助手用哪种方式生成回复，并配合工具查询行情、新闻和历史数据。: Determines how the stock Q&A assistant generates replies and uses tools to query quotes, news, and historical data.
凭证 30 分钟有效，仅首次设置需要。不要分享给他人。: The credential is valid for 30 minutes and is only needed for initial setup. Do not share it with others.
分开评估美股的利率估值链与增长盈利链。: Evaluate the interest rate valuation chain and the growth earnings chain for US stocks separately.
分析 {0} 的商业质量、估值与风险: Analyze the business quality, valuation and risks of {0}
分析{0}的趋势与关键位置: Analyze the trend and key levels of {0}
分析业绩预期、政策预期和估值预期的变化，寻找预期差修复或预期过热后的回落风险。: Analyze changes in earnings expectations, policy expectations, and valuation expectations to identify expectation-gap corrections or pullback risks after expectations become overheated.
分析任务没有添加到市场看板，请稍后重试。: The analysis task was not added to the market dashboard. Please try again later.
分析关注点（不会自动变为筛选规则）: Analysis focus (will not automatically become filter rules)
分析多只股票或 specialist 模式建议适当调高。: For analyzing multiple stocks or specialist mode, it is recommended to increase this appropriately.
分析订阅创建失败，请检查能力配置、运行时间和服务状态。: Failed to create analysis subscription. Please check the capability configuration, runtime, and service status.
分析订阅删除失败，请稍后重试。: Failed to delete analysis subscription. Please try again later.
切换市场即可读取真实指数与宏观快照，并结合已保存的 Agent 复盘和资讯服务数: Switch markets to read real index and macro snapshots, combined with saved Agent reviews and information service data. The page will not fill gaps with sample market data; each item will indicate its data time and run status.
列表来自现有 AgentTemplate API；本版只重新明确其产品角色，不修: The list comes from the existing AgentTemplate API; this version only redefines its product role and does not modify the backend model.
创建规则后，后台评估任务会按轮询周期处理已启用的告警。: After a rule is created, background evaluation tasks will process enabled alerts according to the polling cycle.
初始化凭证无效或已过期，请在部署主机上重新生成。: The initialization credential is invalid or has expired. Please regenerate it on the deployment host.
初次录入可用现有股数与平均成本记一笔买入。后续买卖请继续记流水，不要重复录入余额: For initial entry, record a buy using the available shares and average cost. For subsequent trades, continue recording transactions; do not re-enter the balance. This is for bookkeeping only and does not place orders with the broker; if cash flow entries are not added, it will not be used to calculate available funds.
删除后，该对话将不可恢复，确认删除吗？: Once deleted, this conversation cannot be recovered. Confirm deletion?
判断商业模式和能力圈。: Assess the business model and circle of competence.
利率决议、点阵图与官员讲话: Interest rate decisions, dot plot, and official speeches
前往 LLM 配置查看或编辑 Prompt: Go to LLM Configuration to view or edit Prompt
前面的数据源优先使用，失败后再降级到后续数据源。: Prioritize earlier data sources and fall back to later ones on failure.
剩余额度不足以安全启动下一次模型调用。仍可浏览报告和演示。: Insufficient remaining quota to safely start the next model call. You can still browse reports and demos.
动态通知（如告警）有独立的事件和等级评估。: Dynamic notifications (e.g., alerts) have independent event and severity assessments.
动态通知（如告警）有独立的触发和冷却逻辑。: Dynamic notifications (e.g., alerts) have independent trigger and cooldown logic.
勾选一个或多个模型；主模型不会重复加入备选模型。: Select one or more models; the primary model will not be duplicated in the fallback models.
包含多个市场，请分别创建策略账户。: Spans multiple markets; please create strategy accounts separately.
包含管理员自己。按 UTC 日期统计，与成员每日额度一致；计费用量 = 已确认: Includes the administrator themselves. Counted by UTC date, consistent with members' daily quotas; billable usage = confirmed + unconfirmed reserved. Feature categories are attributed by the actual task entry point; historical ones that cannot be confirmed remain uncategorized.
匹配的专家不可用或被停用，本次仅由主 Agent 解读，不自动启用专家。: The matched expert is unavailable or disabled; this run will be interpreted only by the primary Agent, and no expert will be automatically enabled.
区间换手率 = 买卖成交额总和 ÷ 2 ÷ 平均净资产。年化收益按 252 个交: Period turnover rate = total buy/sell turnover ÷ 2 ÷ average net assets. Annualized return is compounded over 252 trading days; Sharpe uses daily excess returns and sample standard deviation; Calmar = annualized return ÷ maximum drawdown, risk-free rate
协作进度读取失败，正在重试；后台运行不会停止。: Failed to read collaboration progress; retrying. Background execution will continue.
协作需要至少 2 位专家；取消全部选择可直接对话。: Collaboration requires at least 2 experts; clear all selections to chat directly.
协议与 Base URL、API Key 所属服务必须匹配。: The protocol must match the service associated with the Base URL and API Key.
协议会影响模型名前缀归一、连接测试和模型发现方式。: Protocol affects model name prefix normalization, connection testing, and model discovery.
单一数据源失败应降级到后续数据源，不应拖垮主流程。: Failure of a single data source should fall back to subsequent data sources and must not block the main flow.
单个 Key 直接填写；多个 Key 使用英文逗号分隔。: Enter a single Key directly; separate multiple Keys with commas.
单个策略失败或超时会进入诊断信息，不阻塞其它策略和最终决策。: Failure or timeout of a single strategy is recorded in diagnostics and does not block other strategies or the final decision.
单个通知渠道失败不应阻断主分析流程。: Failure of a single notification channel should not block the main analysis flow.
单只明确标的、日级趋势与回踩研究，10% 仓位上限和人工确认；只生成模拟提案，不: Research on a single specified symbol, daily trend, and pullback; 10% position cap and manual confirmation; only generates simulated proposals, with no order placement or return guarantees.
单标的研究、策略问答与历史会话: Single-symbol research, strategy Q&A, and historical conversations
单次本地命令行生成可读取的输出大小上限，默认 1048576 字节。: Maximum readable output size for a single local command-line generation; default 1048576 bytes.
单次生成最多等待多少秒，默认 300；主要用于本地 CLI 这类命令行方式。: Maximum seconds to wait for a single generation; default 300; mainly for command-line methods such as local CLI.
单次请求等待上限；超时或服务端错误会有限重试，再切换到其他数据源。: Maximum wait per request; on timeout or server error, retry a limited number of times, then switch to another data source.
单股内核使用平台行情与新闻路由；配置声明不等于抓取成功，请以报告运行诊断判断数据: The single-stock engine uses platform market data and news routing; configuration declarations do not guarantee successful retrieval. Use report run diagnostics to assess data coverage.
单股分析和选股每天运行一次，避免同一天重复生成大量报告或候选池。: Single-stock analysis and stock selection run once per day to avoid generating a large number of duplicate reports or candidate pools on the same day.
卖出数量超过当前可用持仓，请删除或修正对应卖出流水后重试。: Sell quantity exceeds current available position. Delete or correct the corresponding sell transaction and try again.
即使后端接通，也先生成提案，不自动提交真实订单。: Even if the backend is connected, generate proposals first and do not automatically submit real orders.
历史回测与每日模拟，持续跟踪每一笔决策。: Historical backtesting and daily simulation, continuously tracking every decision.
历史报告不随行情自动更新。资料缺失不等于没有风险。: Historical reports do not update automatically with market data. Missing information does not mean there is no risk.
历史汇总存在格式错误。以下仅展示可完整解析的内容，未解析部分保留在原始记录中。: The historical summary has format errors. Only fully parseable content is shown below; unparsed parts remain in the original records.
历史研究，需更新后再判断: Historical research; update before making a judgment
历史观点 · 需更新后再判断: Historical view · Update before making a judgment
压制或释放互联网与成长股估值: Suppress or release valuation for internet and growth stocks
压缩时最近 N 个用户轮次及其后的回复保持原文；留空则跟随当前上下文压缩策略 p: When compressing, the most recent N user turns and subsequent replies remain in original text; leave blank to follow the current context compression strategy profile default.
启用后信任反向代理透传的 X-Forwarded-For 源 IP。: When enabled, trust the source IP passed through by the reverse proxy via X-Forwarded-For.
启用后将多条邮件通知合并发送，减少同一周期邮件数量。: When enabled, multiple email notifications are combined into one, reducing the number of emails per cycle.
启用后按个股分别推送通知；关闭则合并为单条消息。: When enabled, notifications are pushed separately per stock; when disabled, they are combined into a single message.
启用或关闭历史分析回测功能。: Enable or disable historical analysis backtesting.
启用报告完整性检查，避免发送缺字段或异常内容。: Enable report integrity checks to avoid sending missing fields or abnormal content.
启用报告渲染器，将结构化数据渲染为最终通知内容。: Enable the report renderer to render structured data into final notification content.
启用每日定时分析任务。: Enable the daily scheduled analysis task.
启用每日汇总通知，按日合并发送摘要。: Enable daily summary notifications to combine and send summaries by day.
启用渠道模式后，同层运行时优先读取渠道配置。: When channel mode is enabled, the same-layer runtime prioritizes reading channel configuration.
启用美国圣路易斯联储 FRED 官方宏观序列。: Enable the official FRED macroeconomic series from the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.
启用自然语言路由，让 Agent 自动识别意图并选择执行路径。: Enable natural language routing so the Agent automatically identifies intent and selects the execution path.
启用记忆与校准系统，跟踪 Agent 预测准确率并调整置信度。: Enable the memory and calibration system to track the Agent's prediction accuracy and adjust confidence.
启用记忆与校准系统，追踪历史分析准确率并自动调节置信度。: Enable the memory and calibration system to track historical analysis accuracy and automatically adjust confidence.
启用调试模式，输出更多诊断日志。: Enable debug mode to output more diagnostic logs.
启用钉钉应用机器人长连接模式，不是普通钉钉群机器人 Webhook 开关。: Enable DingTalk app bot long-connection mode; this is not the regular DingTalk group bot Webhook switch.
启用钉钉应用机器人长连接模式；不是普通群机器人 Webhook 开关，需配套 A: Enable DingTalk app bot long-connection mode; this is not the regular group bot Webhook switch. It requires App Key/Secret and restarting related processes.
启用飞书应用机器人 / Stream Bot 长连接模式，不是飞书群 Webho: Enable Feishu app bot / Stream Bot long-connection mode; this is not the Feishu group Webhook push switch.
启用飞书应用机器人 / Stream Bot 长连接模式；不是飞书群 Webho: Enable Feishu app bot / Stream Bot long-connection mode; this is not the Feishu group Webhook push switch. It requires App ID/Secret and restarting related processes.

可以先直接使用系统默认来源；需要专用行情、新闻或私有研究数据时再登记。: You can first use the system default sources directly; register dedicated market data, news, or private research data only when needed.
可以取消这项已有选择。: You can cancel this existing selection.
可分别填写 PYTDX_HOST/PYTDX_PORT，也可使用 PYTDX_S: You can fill in PYTDX_HOST/PYTDX_PORT separately, or use PYTDX_SERVERS to enter multiple ip:port entries; PYTDX_SERVERS has higher priority.
可前往 GitHub Releases 下载更新。: You can go to GitHub Releases to download updates.

可复用的金融研究方法和任务流程。: Reusable financial research methods and task workflows.

可用策略取决于 strategies/ 目录中的定义文件。: Available strategies depend on the definition files in the strategies/ directory.

可稍后刷新以获取最新资讯。: Refresh later to get the latest updates.
可能改变主分析路径的 provider 请求 shape；Agent 路径当前只: May change the provider request shape of the main analysis path; the Agent path currently only records diagnostics and does not actively send hints.
可解析且包含 model_list 时，优先级高于 LLM_CHANNELS 和: When it can be parsed and contains model_list, it has higher priority than LLM_CHANNELS and legacy provider keys.

可选 DEBUG、INFO、WARNING、ERROR、CRITICAL；级别越: Optional: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL; higher levels produce less output.
可选 none、forward、backward、forward_additiv: Optional: none, forward, backward, forward_additive, or backward_additive. Default: none.
可选 off、basic 或 debug。非法值会回退为 off。: Optional: off, basic, or debug. Invalid values fall back to off.

可选择独立模型；自动模式继承普通分析主模型。: You can select a standalone model; Auto mode inherits the main model from standard analysis.

启用只表示工作区准备使用该连接，不代表 Server 已连通或其工具已被发现。: Enabling only means the workspace is ready to use the connection; it does not mean the Server is connected or its tools have been discovered.

公网环境不要关闭 SSL 校验。: Do not disable SSL verification in public network environments.
共享冻结任务、数据快照与能力权限。: Shared frozen tasks, data snapshots, and capability permissions.
